title: Protect main and develop
description: Require the checks on pull requests to `main`. Allow board-only pushes straight to `develop`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Applied via gh api. main: PR required (0 approvals), required check 'ci', admins enforced, no force-push, no deletion. develop: no force-push, no deletion; no PR or check requirement, admins not enforced, so board commits push directly.
